ThemeContrastTests.Applying_a_theme_writ.reason: The exact method asserts mutable SolidColorBrush identity in a sparse two-entry Avalonia ResourceDictionary and skips insertion of an absent Volt resource. Electron intentionally publishes a complete CSS palette and has no matching sparse brush dictionary mechanism. Supplemental tests verify exact BoxArt Surface/Flare values, retained root style declaration and mounted controls; native live theme switching verifies no stale control colors. Those tests do not claim the original absent-Volt assertion.

ThemeContrastTests.A_substituted_backdro.reason: The source distinguishes actual compositor refusal, substitution and the requested Mica grant at 40 percent through Avalonia transparency feedback. Electron exposes only the material request, without actual grant or substitution reporting. Supplemental executed tests cover supported requests, unsupported or throwing solid fallback, saved-choice preservation and stale-response rejection; successful requests are not measurements of visible OS material.

ThemeContrastTests.The_field_opens_only_.reason: The original wall/slider sequence opens and closes on actual Avalonia compositor grant/loss notifications, unavailable through Electron. Supplemental executed tests gate panes on positive transparency and a current accepted request, retain opaque fullscreen, reject late responses and fall back after accessibility changes. They do not establish actual desktop-material arrival.

ThemeJsonTests.Every_token_matches_at_ev.reason: The frozen C# exporter captures all 61 named color values for nine themes, both layouts, both content-transparency settings and every five-percent position: 756 states. Electron builtins, original JSON imports and Electron export/import each match every byte. The test-only role adapter also checks original extra-alpha and Fluent scrollbar arithmetic; it does not claim Chromium paints Fluent templates. The independent comparison corrected premature HSV rounding in Bottle green.

UserThemeStoreTests.Preparing_the_theme_.reason: The original fixture has no configured theme store, rather than a missing directory on disk. Actual ThemeStudio without the optional store bridge omits the authored folder card and folder button and reports no folder problem. Folder creation tests are not substituted for this contract.

Fullscreen is verified separately. Playwright focus emulation is disabled for this proof so document focus observes the actual native transfer; no raw preventScroll call replaces the application behavior.

DawnControlContrastTests.Desktop_action_.reason: Both original Dawn palettes exercise production primary/quiet actions and the actual destructive confirmation through normal, hover, pressed and keyboard-focus states. Computed text contrast stays at least 4.5 and focus contrast at least 3. Electron uses an external offset outline, measured against its actual adjacent parent surface; the source used an inner border over the button fill. Disabled states are recorded separately without inventing new thresholds.

Both palettes and actual pointer states are measured in the native renderer.

DawnControlContrastTests.Fullscreen_real.reason: The real fullscreen action component preserves both Dawn palettes and normal, hover, pressed, keyboard-focus and current states.
